title: Modeled inside M6x1 thread in a d5 through hole (size taken from the hole)

expect.note: Fusion takes the size from the face's diameter and gives a threaded hole the thread's minor diameter (Autodesk): the d5 hole is M5x0.8 6H (until beta.4 it was matched by its tap drill: M6). A modeled thread lies in the middle of its class's tolerance zone (ISO 965-1, thread_tables.class_zone): the hole is filled in to the middle of the minor diameter's zone (2.117408) and the groove moved out; slice change beyond the hole thread_core.removed_area(2.531172, 0.8, True, 2.5, 2.117408) = -3.043734527 (negative: more is added than the grooves take); V = 12000 - (pi 2.5^2 10 + 10 * that)
